source.name: Headline Grouping Dataset classification release 0.1
source.paper: Laban, Bandarkar, and Hearst (2021), News Headline Grouping as a Challenging NLU Task

limitations: The development split informed the fixed thresholds; the test split did not.
The combined count satisfies the proposed-merge sample gate, but it includes the development split and must not be described as an untouched holdout result.
HLGD contains newsroom headlines, not the compound episode and clip titles common in the Observatory panel.
Low recall is an intentional consequence of the precision-first rule, not evidence that most same-event pairs are detected.
A blind human audit of at least 100 locally proposed merges remains required before activation or publication.
